Paste this as a PR comment once independent review is complete.
See docs/GITHUB_GOVERNANCE.md §5 for the rules this format enforces —
most importantly: a review is valid ONLY for the exact commit SHA it names.
A new commit on the branch makes the review below stale; repeat it.
-->

## APSA Independent Review

- Reviewer: <name, or "Claude" / "Codex" + session identifier>
- Reviewed commit SHA: <full 40-char SHA — `git rev-parse HEAD`>
- Result: BLOCK | READY TO MERGE
- Blockers:
  - <blocker 1, or "None">
- Residual risks:
  - <risk 1, or "None">
- Timestamp: <ISO 8601, e.g. 2026-09-06T12:00:00Z>
- Hosted migration status: <e.g. "No migrations in this PR" / "Migrations NOT applied to hosted Supabase — project-owner action required" / "N/A">
